chat.description: an open conversation between an actor and an entity — one per actor/entity pair

from.description: whose act or words it tells, where it tells someone's: the actor who finished a task or commented on it, the person who sent a text

about.description: what it tells of, where that is one entity: the task a mark or an assignment moved, or the comment on it

knock.description: a nudge aimed at an entity, with the message that came with it

to.description: whom it tells: a person, or a space or project for everyone standing in it; it may live in another graph

about.description: what it tells of, which may live in another graph

from.description: the entry it was written from, where its reader opens the conversation it came from

notification.description: words emitted, not said, telling whoever its `to` names (a person, or a space or project for everyone standing in it) what happened; doc{body} holds them, and it is a thread of its own

mode.description: watch: notify this actor. mute: do not

subscription.description: one actor’s attention to one entity; mode watches or mutes it, and archived/opened marks on this row record putting away or reading its thread

whereabouts.description: where a person is available on one channel, as it last changed: one row per person, channel and place, its eid derived from the three (@yaks/notify/whereabouts `whereaboutsEid`). A row is written when its state changes, or again while it holds once it is old enough to fade; a row older than its channel's fade says nothing.

channel.description: where: the Operator's page, a yaks.app app's page, Discord, a text, an email

place.description: which one of the channel, where there are several: the space whose Operator page, the app whose page; none for a channel the person is on once

state.description: what the channel last said: an Operator page focused (here), open but hidden or unfocused (background), or closed (away); an app page open or closed (away); Discord's status; a text or email used

at.description: when the state was last said, which it fades from

knock.description: a nudge aimed at an entity, with the message that came with it

notification.description: words emitted, not said, telling whoever its `to` names (a person, or a space or project for everyone standing in it) what happened; doc{body} holds them, and it is a thread of its own

subscription.description: one actor’s attention to one entity; mode watches or mutes it, and archived/opened marks on this row record putting away or reading its thread
